tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, and Kubernetes. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your team as an SAP Commerce Cloud Developer. With over 5 years of professional experience specializing in enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, and headless integrations.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring for product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST APIs & OCC
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and customized Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows and headless storefront consumers.

bullets.label: System Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub while resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: CI/CD & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period ending on 15 December 2026, and I will be available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can benefit your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to your engineering team. Having successfully delivered scalable enterprise solutions, integrations, and optimizations for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about applying my Java, Spring, and headless API skills to your platform.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, robust Java and Spring backend skills, and proven experience in enterprise e-commerce integrations to drive your platform's success.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, specializing in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs. I have a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026. I would love to connect about your opening.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Cloud Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and system integrations. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, and my earliest start date is 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
